title: Sorting out the sequence of Henderson, Waller and Tapp
summary: Tape 2 opens. Dance's reference book gives a different chronology, but Thomas insists he joined Henderson in 1934, then Waller, then Tapp, then Henderson again in 1935. Henderson used scouts and Keg Johnson recommended him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, he's got it, see the way this cat is he has you, Fletcher Henderson, then Ferman Tapp, then back with Fletcher and then with Fats Waller much later.

No, no. That sequence isn't quite right. He may be on the right track a little more/... than I am. What I did comes into Charlie Turner to Henderson. See, Henderson was the type of fellow who had scouts out.
Scouts. /Wanted/ the guys who could play, he wanted always to improve his band.
Like the baseball players with scouts out so somehow my name came up and I think it must have/ been through Keg Johnson. Tremendous trombone player.

And he and Claude Jones were in the trombone section, two trombones, you know. So, during that time I think I went to Fats and then to Ferman Tapp and then back to Smack. After I left Fats, I went back to Smack.
Oh, well, this guy has that wrong then.
I wouldn't say he's wrong. I may be wrong, too. Years pass fast.
Well, I know. It's a long, long time but I was just trying to think how these dates came out for Fletcher.

Yes. Well, that's what he's got. With Fletcher for a few months early in 1934, with Ferman Tapp's band at Smalls 9/34. Regularly with Fletcher from the summer of 1935 until '37 and with Fats Waller and Willy Bryant before joining Benny Carter in May in 1939.

Impossible. Because during that time I met a young worked lady there. No, in '34 I were with Smack (?) to Fats Waller, met Joe Jordan and he was nige enough to offer this job with Ferman Thurman Tapp and back to Smack in '35.
Well, how long do you think you were with Fats Waller?
